services:
  postgres:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: legacy_assistant
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-local_postgres_only}
      DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD: ${DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD:-local_migration_only}
      DB_APP_PASSWORD: ${DB_APP_PASSWORD:-local_app_only}
      RAG_DB_PASSWORD: ${RAG_DB_PASSWORD:-local_rag_reader_only}
      EVALUATION_DB_PASSWORD: ${EVALUATION_DB_PASSWORD:-local_evaluation_reader_only}
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/postgres/init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d legacy_assistant"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  backend:
    build: ./backend
    environment:
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_NAME: legacy_assistant
      DB_APP_USER: app_user
      DB_APP_PASSWORD: ${DB_APP_PASSWORD:-local_app_only}
      DB_MIGRATION_USER: migration_owner
      DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD: ${DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD:-local_migration_only}
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  ai-service:
    build: ./ai-service
    environment:
      RAG_DB_HOST: postgres
      RAG_DB_NAME: legacy_assistant
      RAG_DB_USER: rag_reader
      RAG_DB_PASSWORD: ${RAG_DB_PASSWORD:-local_rag_reader_only}
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    ports:
      - "5173:5173"
    depends_on:
      - backend
      - ai-service

volumes:
  postgres-data:
server:
  port: 8080

spring:
  datasource:
    url: jdbc:postgresql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:5432/${DB_NAME:legacy_assistant}?currentSchema=app
    username: ${DB_APP_USER:app_user}
    password: ${DB_APP_PASSWORD:local_app_only}
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    url: jdbc:postgresql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:5432/${DB_NAME:legacy_assistant}?currentSchema=app
    user: ${DB_MIGRATION_USER:migration_owner}
    password: ${DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD:local_migration_only}
    default-schema: app
    schemas: app,rag
    locations: classpath:db/migration
  sql:
    init:
      mode: never

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health
  endpoint:
    health:
      show-details: always
CREATE TABLE app.requirement (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT requirement_status_check CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'ANALYZED', 'REVIEWED'))
);

CREATE TABLE rag.knowledge_document (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    document_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    source_name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT knowledge_document_type_check CHECK (document_type IN ('BUSINESS_RULE', 'API_SPEC'))
);

CREATE TABLE rag.knowledge_chunk (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES rag.knowledge_document(id),
    section VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    embedding public.vector
);
-- Runtime access is limited to business tables, not migration metadata.
REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE app.flyway_schema_history FROM app_user;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

\getenv migration_password DB_MIGRATION_PASSWORD
\getenv app_password DB_APP_PASSWORD
\getenv rag_password RAG_DB_PASSWORD
\getenv evaluation_password EVALUATION_DB_PASSWORD

SELECT format('CREATE ROLE migration_owner LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'migration_password') \gexec
SELECT format('CREATE ROLE app_user LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'app_password') \gexec
SELECT format('CREATE ROLE rag_reader LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'rag_password') \gexec
SELECT format('CREATE ROLE evaluation_reader LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'evaluation_password') \gexec

CREATE SCHEMA app AUTHORIZATION migration_owner;
CREATE SCHEMA rag AUTHORIZATION migration_owner;
CREATE SCHEMA evaluation AUTHORIZATION migration_owner;

GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA app TO app_user;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA rag TO rag_reader;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA evaluation TO evaluation_reader;

ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE migration_owner IN SCHEMA app
  GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO app_user;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE migration_owner IN SCHEMA app
  GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO app_user;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE migration_owner IN SCHEMA rag
  GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO rag_reader;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE migration_owner IN SCHEMA evaluation
  GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO evaluation_reader;
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'

export default defineConfig({

      '/ai-health': {
        target: 'http://ai-service:8000',
        rewrite: (path) => path.replace(/^\/ai-health/, ''),
      },
    },
  },
})

FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS build
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY pom.xml .
COPY src ./src
RUN mvn -B -DskipTests package

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /workspace/target/legacy-change-assistant-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app ./app
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json .
COPY package-lock.json .
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
EXPOSE 5173
CMD ["npm", "run", "dev", "--", "--host", "0.0.0.0"]
